title: America PANICS as Japan DUMPS $35.6B US Bonds - EU is Next to SELL
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: Japan dumped $35.6B of Treasuries to defend the yen; Japanese banks/investors repatriating; Europe (holding ~$2T) could follow if US sides with Russia.
10y at 5.1% and 30y at 5.4% are cracking the US economy and hurting tech; more spending pressure means higher yields.
Expects a weaker dollar and yen strengthening vs USD down the road.
US buying Russian energy would raise prices for Europe, fund Russia, and erode allies' trust; won't split Russia from China.
Consumer sentiment at historic lows; spending depends on high asset prices and an unsustainable AI capex boom.

calls.reason: Foreign selling of Treasuries (Japan, possibly EU), deficits and inflationary policy push yields higher.
calls.quote: I expect more pressure for US spending, a weaker dollar, and higher bond yields

calls.reason: Foreign holders repatriating, yen expected to strengthen, spending pressure.
